prompt:
A desktop marketing landing page for White Sail Labs, an independent market research lab, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is an investor, CEO or strategist deciding whether to request early access. White Sail Labs sells research as a subscription: applied AI engineers and business engineers build an always-on fleet of agents that keeps a living model of every company, and each new fact's surprise travels along the value chain to suppliers and customers.

The category standard for an AI research platform, executed at full craft and played straight. A top navigation bar with a solid sail silhouette and three short speed lines beside the wordmark White Sail Labs, links Who we are, Capabilities, Careers, Contact, and a Request early access button. A large centred headline "Your decisions. Better informed." with the line "A research lab of people and agents, not an AI tool." and two buttons, Request early access and Get in touch. Below, a large product panel showing the agents at work on a research brief: "NVIDIA Q3: revenue $57.0B vs model $54.1B, surprise +$2.9B; effects on TSMC and Microsoft", with a small Illustrative label. At the bottom edge the next section begins with a heading "How the lab works".

Visual law: clean white ground, near-black type in a modern grotesk, brand navy #1a3263 as the single accent, soft shadows and a crisp grid.
note: The render invented coverage counts (companies modeled, relationships mapped); they are not claims and must not ship.
